q.q: What is the relationship between authentication and authorization in OpenShift?
o: They are separate steps: first confirm who the user is, then decide what the user can do
They are the same step performed by the OAuth server
Authorization is optional when authentication succeeds
q.e: 驗證與授權是兩個獨立的步驟：先確認使用者是誰，再決定使用者可以做什麼。

q.q: Which resource records the mapping between a user and an identity provider?
q.e: Identity 記錄使用者與 Identity Provider 之間的對應；User 代表人員或應用程式本身。

q.q: What is a service account?
o: A system user associated with a project that workloads use to call the API
A user that can log in to the web console with a password
q.e: Service Account 是與 Project 關聯的系統使用者，供 Workload 呼叫 API。

q.q: Which roles does a new service account have by default?
o: No roles; they must be granted separately
The edit role in its project
The view role in all projects
q.e: 簡報強調 Service Account 預設沒有任何 Role，需要另外授予，Workload 才能使用特定 API。

q.q: What is the difference between a role and a cluster role?
o: A cluster role applies to the entire cluster, while a role is scoped to a project
A role applies to the cluster, while a cluster role applies to one project
A cluster role can only be bound to groups
q.e: Role 與 Cluster Role 都是一組可執行的操作 (Rule)，Cluster Role 適用整個 Cluster，Role 則限於單一 Project。

q.q: How does a user typically obtain an OAuth access token?
o: By authenticating through the OpenShift OAuth server
By reading the kubeconfig file of the installer
By creating a Secret in openshift-config
q.e: 使用者透過 OAuth Server 驗證後取得 OAuth Access Token，再附在 API 請求中。

q.q: How are API requests treated when they have no authentication or invalid authentication?
o: As requests from the system:anonymous user
They are always accepted as cluster-admin
As requests from the kubeadmin user
They are queued until a token is provided
q.e: 沒有驗證或驗證無效的請求，視為 system:anonymous 使用者。

q.q: Which authentication method is commonly used in the cluster administrator's kubeconfig file?
q.e: X.509 Client Certificate 以憑證識別使用者，常用於 Cluster 管理員的 kubeconfig。

q.q: In the authentication flow, which component validates the user's credentials?
q.e: OAuth Server 把驗證工作交給 Identity Provider 確認帳號與密碼，驗證成功後才簽發 Access Token。

q.q: After the API server validates a token, what determines whether the requested operation is allowed?
o: RBAC evaluation of the user's roles and role bindings
q.e: API Server 驗證 Token 後，由 RBAC 評估使用者的 Role 與 Role Binding，決定是否允許操作。

q.q: Where do you configure the identity providers that OpenShift uses?
o: In the OAuth custom resource named cluster
In a ConfigMap in the default namespace
q.e: 在 OAuth Custom Resource 設定要使用的 Identity Provider，而且可同時設定多個。

q.q: Which of the following is NOT listed as an identity provider type in the course?
q.e: 簡報列出的類型包括 HTPasswd、Keystone、LDAP、GitHub 與 OpenID Connect，並未列出 Kerberos keytab。

q.q: How many identity providers can be configured at the same time?
o: Multiple identity providers can be configured
q.e: OAuth Custom Resource 可同時設定多個 Identity Provider。

q.q: On ROSA and OpenShift Dedicated, how do you configure identity providers?
o: With the rosa or ocm CLI or the Hybrid Cloud Console, not with YAML
By editing the OAuth resource with oc edit
By creating an htpasswd Secret in openshift-config
q.e: 在 ROSA 與 OpenShift Dedicated 無法用 YAML 設定 Identity Provider，需改用 rosa、ocm 或 Hybrid Cloud Console；ARO 則與自管 Cluster 做法相同。

q.q: Which two methods for administrator access does OpenShift create during installation?
o: A kubeconfig file and the kubeadmin virtual user
An htpasswd file and an LDAP bind user
A GitHub OAuth app and a service account
A cluster-admin group and a Secret
q.e: 安裝時會建立 kubeconfig 檔 (以 X.509 憑證驗證的 system:admin) 與 kubeadmin 虛擬使用者兩種管理驗證方式。

q.q: Which user is represented by the certificate in the installer-generated kubeconfig file?
q.e: kubeconfig 檔中憑證使用者為 system:admin，擁有最高權限，且不需要 Identity Provider。

q.q: What should you confirm before deleting the kubeadmin user?
o: That another user already has the cluster-admin role
That the kubeconfig file has been deleted
That no identity providers are configured
That all projects have been deleted
q.e: 刪除 kubeadmin 之前，先確認已有其他使用者擁有 cluster-admin 角色。本課程環境則請勿刪除 kubeadmin。

q.q: Which htpasswd option creates a new file?
q.e: -c 建立新檔，只在第一次建立時使用；-B 以 bcrypt 雜湊；-b 從 Command-line 讀取密碼；-D 刪除使用者。

q.q: Why should you NOT use the -c option when adding a second user to an existing htpasswd file?
q.e: -c 會建立新檔，若對既有檔案使用會覆蓋原檔，因此新增使用者時不加 -c。

q.q: Which htpasswd option hashes the password with bcrypt?
q.e: -B 以 bcrypt 雜湊密碼；小寫 -b 則是從 Command-line 讀取密碼。

q.q: Which command removes the user developer from /tmp/htpasswd?
q.e: htpasswd -D 從檔案刪除使用者。

q.q: In which namespace must you create the Secret that holds the htpasswd file?
q.e: HTPasswd 的 Secret 建立在 openshift-config Namespace，再由 OAuth Custom Resource 參照。

q.q: Which command creates the htpasswd Secret?
o: oc create secret generic htpasswd-secret --from-file htpasswd=/tmp/htpasswd -n openshift-config
q.e: 以 oc create secret generic 並用 --from-file htpasswd=FILE 建立，key 名稱為 htpasswd，位於 openshift-config。

q.q: In the OAuth custom resource, which field points the HTPasswd identity provider to the Secret?
q.e: 在 .spec.identityProviders 的 htpasswd 區段，以 fileData.name 指向 Secret 名稱。

q.q: Which mappingMethod value does the course use for the HTPasswd identity provider?
q.e: 範例中 mappingMethod 設為 claim。

q.q: After editing the exported oauth.yaml file, which command applies the change?
q.e: 簡報以 oc replace -f oauth.yaml 套用 OAuth 變更。

q.q: Why must you wait after changing the HTPasswd configuration or Secret?
o: The Authentication Operator redeploys the pods in openshift-authentication, and the old settings remain until then
The API server must be rebooted
q.e: Authentication Operator 偵測到變更後會重新部署 openshift-authentication 的 Pod，通常需要幾分鐘，完成前舊設定仍然有效。

q.q: Which command extracts the htpasswd file from the Secret so that you can modify it?
q.e: oc extract 取出 Secret 的檔案資料，--confirm 允許覆寫目的地已存在的檔案。

q.q: Which command writes the modified htpasswd file back to the Secret?
o: oc set data secret/htpasswd-secret --from-file htpasswd=/tmp/htpasswd -n openshift-config
q.e: oc set data secret 把修改後的檔案寫回 Secret。

q.q: You removed the user manager from the htpasswd file. What else must you do to delete the user completely?
o: Delete the identity (for example, myusers:manager) and the user resource
Nothing; the user is removed automatically
q.e: 光從檔案移除使用者不夠，Identity 與 User 資源仍然存在，還要執行 oc delete identity myusers:manager 與 oc delete user manager。

q.q: What is the name format of the identity created for user manager from an identity provider named myusers?
q.e: 範例刪除 Identity 時使用 myusers:manager，即 Identity Provider 名稱加冒號加使用者名稱。

q.q: Which command makes the user new_admin a cluster administrator?
o: oc adm policy add-cluster-role-to-user cluster-admin new_admin
oc adm groups add-users cluster-admin new_admin
q.e: oc adm policy add-cluster-role-to-user cluster-admin 授予 Cluster 管理員角色。oc policy add-role-to-user admin 只授予 Project 內的 admin。

q.q: When granting a role to a user who has never logged in, you see 'Warning: User new_admin not found'. What should you do?
o: Ignore it; the binding is still created
Create the user resource manually first
q.e: 使用者尚未登入過時會出現 User not found 的警告，可以忽略，Binding 仍會建立。

q.q: Which simple command verifies that a user has cluster administrator privileges?
q.e: 只有管理員能列出 Node，一般使用者會被拒絕，因此 oc get nodes 是驗證授權是否生效的簡單方法。

q.q: In RBAC, what is a rule?
o: An allowed action on an object or group of objects
A mapping of users to roles
q.e: Rule 是對物件或物件群組允許的操作；Role 是 Rule 的集合；Binding 把使用者或群組指派給 Role。

q.q: Which RBAC object assigns a user or group to a role?
q.e: Binding 把使用者或群組指派給 Role。

q.q: A role binding in a project references a cluster role. What is the scope of the resulting permissions?
q.e: Local Role Binding 限定在單一 Project，可參照 Cluster Role，但權限只限於該 Project。

q.q: Which command shows who can delete users in the cluster?
o: oc adm policy who-can delete user
q.e: oc adm policy who-can 查詢誰可以對某個資源執行某項操作，有助於檢查權限是否過大。

q.q: Which command removes the cluster-admin role from a user?
o: oc adm policy remove-cluster-role-from-user cluster-admin username
oc adm groups remove-users cluster-admin username
q.e: remove-cluster-role-from-user 移除使用者的 Cluster Role。

q.q: Which default role can manage all project resources, including granting access to other users?
q.e: admin 可管理 Project 的所有資源，含授予其他使用者存取權，也能管理 Quota 與限制。

q.q: What can a user with the edit role NOT do?
o: Manage limit ranges, quotas, or project permissions
q.e: edit 可建立、修改、刪除常見應用程式資源，但不能管理限制與 Quota，或 Project 權限。

q.q: Which default role can view most objects in the cluster but cannot modify them?
q.e: cluster-reader 可檢視大多數物件但不能修改；cluster-status 只存取 Cluster 狀態資訊。

q.q: Which group is the self-provisioner role bound to by default?
q.e: self-provisioner 預設 Bind 到 system:authenticated:oauth 群組，所以所有通過驗證的使用者都能建立 Project。

q.q: On managed services, which role gives full access that bypasses the managed service protections and should be given only to a few platform architects?
q.e: 託管服務的 cluster-admins 有完全存取並會略過託管服務的保護；dedicated-admins 只管理使用者建立的 Project，不能修改控制平面與核心 Operator。

q.q: Which command grants the edit role to the group dev-group in the wordpress project?
o: oc policy add-role-to-group edit dev-group -n wordpress
oc adm policy add-cluster-role-to-group edit dev-group
oc adm groups add-users dev-group edit
q.e: oc policy add-role-to-group 對群組授予 Project 內的角色，-n 指定 Project。

q.q: If you omit the -n option with 'oc policy add-role-to-user', which project is used?
q.e: 以 -n 指定 Project；省略時使用目前的 Project。

q.q: How do system user names typically begin?
q.e: System User 多在基礎架構定義時自動建立，名稱以 system: 開頭，例如 system:admin。

q.q: What prefix do service account user names have?
q.e: Service Account 的名稱以 system:serviceaccount:namespace: 開頭。

q.q: Which command creates a group named lead-developers?
q.e: oc adm groups new 建立 Group，oc adm groups add-users 把使用者加入 Group。

q.q: In the RBAC guided exercise, qa-engineer can list Deployments but cannot scale them. Why?
o: The qa-group has only the view role
The qa-group has the edit role, which forbids scaling
q.e: 練習中 qa-group 只被授予 view 角色，可以檢視 Deployment，但沒有修改權限，因此無法 scale。
